subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should OpenClaw accept the helper-level CDP control-plane exception from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100986, or require a distinct CDP-control policy path before merging a fix for this issue?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the repair changes how a browser SSRF boundary treats loopback CDP control traffic when `hostnameAllowlist` is configured.

options.title: Accept the scoped helper fix after proof
options.body: Allow the exact loopback CDP host through an existing hostname allowlist for control-plane checks once live proof shows navigate works and remote/non-loopback CDP remains blocked.

options.title: Require a separate control-policy path
options.body: Keep the helper exact-host-only and instead route Playwright/CDP connection paths through an explicitly separate CDP control policy.

options.title: Keep strict operator configuration
options.body: Require users to add the local CDP host to `hostnameAllowlist` manually and update docs/tests to make that burden intentional.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped helper fix after proof
recommendation.body: Allow the exact loopback CDP host through an existing hostname allowlist for control-plane checks once live proof shows navigate works and remote/non-loopback CDP remains blocked.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared helper shape and are the best routed owner for deciding whether the helper should carry the CDP control-plane exception.
